title: Relocation of Cape Town baboons to sanctuary ignites heated protests
summary_full: Demonstrators tried to block vehicle carrying the baboons, whose capture authorities say is needed to protect both primate and humanThe relocation of a troop of baboons in Cape Town to a wildlife sanctuary has triggered furious protests by local people opposed to their capture, which officials argue is necessary to stop human-wildlife conflict in the city.The 44-member Waterfall troop (named after the area they mainly inhabit) was captured in the southern seaside suburb of Simon’s Town on Friday and Saturday. A second, smaller Seaforth troop is also due to be moved. Continue reading...
